item.content:encoded:
Just sold all my XMR for ZEC

Open thread • Replies: 2 • Updated: 2026-10-11 06:49 UTC

OP

Fully exiting XMR.
CPU mining is a weak security model. A single pool already pushed serious hashrate at the chain. A nation-state does not need a new idea, just more machines. The cost of a majority attack is hardware you can rent, not a factory you have to build.
No crypto agility. The protocol cannot swap out its cryptography without a slow, contentious hard fork. Quantum is not the only threat that requires that. If the math breaks, there is no clean upgrade path, and the old chain stays readable.
No liquidity. You can barely buy or sell it. Institutions will not touch a coin they cannot custody, list, or exit. No new money, no bid. Privacy without a market is just a bag you cannot leave.
The reputation does not help either. Congrats on sticking to principles, but I care more about making money.

AI today is the worst it will ever be, so that means whatever the rate of miracles it produces today is, that rate will only increase as time goes on. Nobody can prove that AI has or will break modern cryptography, but nobody can prove that it won't, either. Meanwhile the miracles keep coming, faster and faster. If you're holding the bag when the wrong miracle happens, it goes to zero overnight. Everyone perceives this new state of affairs and sees that there is no expiration date on it, and elects to sell before other people sell because in this new state of affairs you can either sell now, sell later for less, or hold until cryptography breaks and your bags go to zero.

Again, this is all bullshit. Nobody's going to break ecdsa or public key cryptography. And if they did, they wouldn't blow their cover by draining a crypto wallet. And if they did, they would never bother targeting your wallet. And none of this matters, because crypto is a beauty contest where the only thing that matters is guessing what other people are thinking and then acting on that information before they do. This is not like quantum where qday is approaching, but we can measure its approach and take appropriate measures ahead of time. This is a situation where the break might already be here, and by the time you can know it is it's already too late. So the only sane thing to do is sell now before you can't sell at all.
